description: This file implements the DobbyEventListener class and its nested OCIContainerNotification class, which handle container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes, and send corresponding events to a runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: A class that listens to container events and forwards them to the runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification
classes.description: A nested class that handles specific container notifications such as start, stop, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::DobbyEventListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the notification handler and logs creation.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the listener with service, event handler, and OCI container object, and registers for notifications.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters the notification handler and cleans up.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles container start event and sends notification.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles container stop event and sends notification.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles container failure event and sends notification.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification::OnContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles container state change events, maps container states to runtime states, and sends notification.
